notes: Official FSU-FP04-F0-W1 (FP-ScalarProbe). The workload covers FP32/FP64 add/sub/mul/div/sqrt/FMA, NaN/Inf/+-0/subnormal, four rounding modes, and FPSR/FPCR snapshots with a bit-level ARRAYHASH. This F0 run injects the FP32 scalar sign bit with decode_guard=true, so FP64/FCVT candidates are rejected and not counted. W1 coverage remains partial: one field/one precision is injected per seed.
